sources.label: Morphe patches for Android apps
sources.author: App
patch_list: Points the product-ad API endpoint at a non-existent path so in-app ad banners are not loaded. Best effort: ads embedded in content responses are not affected.

Disables Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and Performance, stops Sentry uploads and turns off Facebook app events. The firebase_data_collection_default_enabled flag also prevents the SDKs from re-enabling collection.
Removes the advertising ID, Privacy Sandbox ad-services and Play install-referrer permissions. Device identification used for device management is left untouched.
Removes calendar read/write permissions. Programme reminders will no longer work.
Removes VTVGo pre-roll, mid-roll, welcome TVC and other VAST/IMA ads by rejecting ad requests before playback starts.
Adds user-installed CA certificates to the network security config so native traffic can be inspected with a debugging proxy. Flutter's Dart HTTP stack keeps its own trust store.
